title: mnemonica .tactica hierarchy
description: The type tree of one .tactica source (format version 1.0/1.1). Node identity is the dot-joined fullPath, optionally prefixed with the owning collection id (`collection_N::`); see tactica/README.md for the rules a schema cannot say.

version.description: Format version. Absent means 1.0 (pre-versioning and 1.0 outputs are identical in shape).

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of generation. Informational only; readers must not require it.

roots.description: Root type nodes, in discovery order. May be empty when the source declares no types.

name.description: The declared type name. Never collection-prefixed; equal to the last dotted segment of fullPath.

fullPath.description: Dot-joined path from the root: `<parentFullPath>.<name>`. Collection roots carry the `<collectionId>::` prefix; default-collection (global registry) types never do.

location.description: `file:line:col`, 1-based line and column, relative to the project root (forward slashes). Files outside the project root may stay absolute.

children.description: Subtypes declared on this type. May be empty; the field is always present.
